name: Quinoa Tabbouleh Salad with Chickpeas & Feta Cheese

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and broth; bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the quinoa comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumber
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ small bunch fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Once the quinoa is boiling, reduce heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Halve the tomatoes lengthwise and transfer to a large bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; medium dice the cucumber and add to the bowl.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; add to the bowl.
Measure out the feta and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, combine and whisk together the minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemon
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork; add to the bowl with the rest of the ingredients.
Add the dressing and toss the salad until well combined.
Divide the salad between plates and enjoy!
